title: cuscuta umbellata var. reflexa
intro: Cuscuta umbellata var. reflexa, commonly known as Dodder, is a parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the vascular tissues of its host plant. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cuscuta umbellata var. reflexa include its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory problems, and alleviate diarrhea. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
